name: werun-coaching
description: The site ships no dependencies at all — every script in js/ is plain, unbundled JavaScript the browser loads directly, and that is not going to change. This file is for the tools: wrangler, which runs the Worker and the D1 database locally and applies migrations on deploy, and two libraries the QR test uses to check js/qr.js against a real encoder and a real decoder. Nothing here reaches the athletes.
